Azure API Management policy reference
Feedback
Summarize this article for me
APPLIES TO: All API Management tiers
This article lists all Azure API Management policies, with brief descriptions and links to the reference article for each policy. Each table indicates the Azure API Management
gateways
that support the policy. For detailed policy settings and examples, see the linked reference articles.
More information about policies:
Policy overview
Set or edit policies
Policy expressions
Policy snippets repo
Azure API Management policy toolkit
Author policies using Azure Copilot
Important
Limit call rate by subscription
and
Set usage quota by subscription
have a dependency on the subscription key. A subscription key isn't required when other policies are applied.
